# Harness Engineering: The Free, Complete Course

> A free course on harness engineering: designing the system around an AI agent (instructions, context, tools, sandboxes, permissions, state, memory, guardrails, tests, evals, observability, feedback, loops, graphs and human control) so it completes useful work reliably. 18 lessons, 11 tested Python projects, 12 videos and a small teaching harness, harnesslab.

Definition: Harness engineering is the practice of designing the system around an AI agent so the agent has the information, tools, environment, constraints, feedback, and control mechanisms it needs to complete useful work reliably.
